fields.System.Title: INV-503 — Consume a reservation on pick
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want a pick to reduce on-hand and reserved together, so that
availability never goes negative and the two numbers never drift apart.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a pick against a reservation, then qty_on_hand and qty_reserved both
  • decrease by the picked quantity in one statement.
  • - Given the pick, then the reservation row is closed or reduced accordingly.
  • - Given a pick larger than the reservation, then it is rejected.
  • - Given any sequence of picks, shorts, and cancels, then
  • 0 <= qty_reserved <= qty_on_hand holds throughout.
  • - Given the pick, then the stock movement is written in the same transaction.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory |
| Tables | stock_balance, reservation, stock_movement |
| Risks | On-hand and reserved diverge ([doc 09 §2.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); reservation not consumed ([doc 09 §5.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · property/invariant · rollback |
